name: Mastery-seeking behaviour
description: Participants describe wanting to feel expert and capable, often customising workflows and pushing advanced features to the limit.
quotes: I want to know I'm using this thing properly, like a power user.
Every time I find a shortcut I feel a little proud.
The advanced settings — that's where I live, honestly.

name: Friction during early setup
description: Participants in the first session frequently mentioned not knowing where to start. The onboarding tour was perceived as long or skippable.
quotes: I just bounced. I didn't know what the first thing I should do was.
Honestly the setup felt like homework. I closed the tab.
I came back two weeks later and started over from scratch.

name: Permissions anxiety
description: Admins describe a recurring anxiety around accidentally exposing data when changing workspace permissions or billing settings.
quotes: Every time I touch permissions I get a little knot in my stomach.
Billing and admin together feels like one wrong click and I've broken something.
I'd love a clearer permissions preview before I commit to changes.

name: Time-of-week as identity
description: Several participants framed their usage as 'a weekend thing' — a personal project space distinct from weekday work tools.
quotes: It's my Saturday morning ritual. Coffee, this tool, my own projects.
I deliberately don't open it during the week. It's not for work.
Weekend-only — it's almost a hobby at this point.

name: Quiet collaborators
description: Some participants prefer asynchronous, low-touch collaboration — they avoid live editing and prefer leaving comments.
quotes: I don't love when someone's in the doc at the same time.
I'd rather get the thing right alone, then share it.
